lines.zh: 我跟在首领身后，保持半个身位。
lines.en: I trail my leader, holding half a body behind.

lines.zh: 鱼群掠过珊瑚枝，影子一片片滑过。
lines.en: The school sweeps the coral branches, shadows sliding past.

lines.zh: 它贴着海草床游，鳍几乎不摆。
lines.en: It glides over the seagrass bed, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 温水海洋里，它顺着礁脊来回巡。
lines.en: In the lukewarm ocean it patrols the reef ridge back and forth.

lines.zh: 首领一加速，整群鱼跟着窜出去。
lines.en: The leader surges and the whole school shoots forward.

lines.zh: 它绕过珊瑚的尖角，动作干净利落。
lines.en: It rounds the coral's sharp horn, clean and precise.

lines.zh: 温暖浅海的光里，它一路小跑。
lines.en: In the warm shallows' light it trots along.

lines.zh: 队形一散，我迅速贴回首领身边。
lines.en: The formation loosens and I quickly tuck back beside the leader.

lines.zh: 它拐弯时不减速，尾巴一绷就过去。
lines.en: It corners without slowing, tail tightening into the turn.

lines.zh: 鱼群绕礁一圈，像被谁牵着走。
lines.en: The school circles the reef as if on a leash.

lines.zh: 它停在珊瑚阴影里，随水轻晃。
lines.en: It rests in coral shade, swaying with the water.

lines.zh: 首领不动，整群鱼也都悬着。
lines.en: The leader halts and the whole school hangs still.

lines.zh: 它半张着嘴，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: Mouth half open, it lets the current pass its gills.

lines.zh: 海草在它身边摇，它一动不动。
lines.en: Seagrass sways around it and it does not move.

lines.zh: 它微微侧身，眼睛盯着礁外。
lines.en: It tilts slightly, eye fixed beyond the reef.

lines.zh: 鱼群散成松散的一团，各自悬停。
lines.en: The school loosens into a drifting cluster.

lines.zh: 我偶尔摆一下尾，只为不被水推走。
lines.en: I flick my tail now and then, only to hold position.

lines.zh: 温水的光斑在它背上一格一格移。
lines.en: Bands of warm light creep along its back.

lines.zh: 它把身体藏在珊瑚的影子里。
lines.en: It tucks its body into the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 一整群鱼安静得像一块石头。
lines.en: The whole school goes quiet as a stone.

lines.zh: 它悬在礁口，像在守着什么。
lines.en: It hovers at the reef mouth, as if guarding something.

lines.zh: 水草床的沙慢慢落下，它也不动。
lines.en: Sand settles slowly on the seagrass bed; it stays still.

lines.zh: 我收着鳍，只留尾尖轻轻颤。
lines.en: Fins folded, I let only my tail tip quiver.

lines.zh: 远处有条大鱼经过，它没有跟上。
lines.en: A big fish passes far off and it does not follow.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁口，随水一沉一浮。
lines.en: I hang at the reef mouth, rising and sinking.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，让光顺鳞滑下。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the light slide off.

lines.zh: 它先看见你，才慢慢转过来。
lines.en: It spots you first, then turns slowly.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛很亮，像在算你的距离。
lines.en: Those bright eyes seem to be measuring your distance.

lines.zh: 它绕着你游了半圈，鳍一直张着。
lines.en: It circles you halfway, fins held wide.

lines.zh: 首领没动，它却先朝你靠近。
lines.en: The leader stays put, yet it approaches you first.

lines.zh: 它停在两步外，直直看着你的手。
lines.en: It stops two steps away, staring at your hands.

lines.zh: 你一动，它立刻抬高半尺。
lines.en: You move and it instantly rises half a foot.

lines.zh: 它侧头看你，像在判断能不能惹。
lines.en: It cocks its head, judging whether you are worth trouble.

lines.zh: 温水浅海里，它盯着你不放。
lines.en: In the warm shallows it keeps its eyes on you.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后，又转回来确认。
lines.en: It slips behind you, then returns to check.

lines.zh: 它离得很近，尾鳍几乎碰到你。
lines.en: It comes so close its tail fin nearly touches you.

lines.zh: 那目光不友好，也没有退让的意思。
lines.en: The look is unfriendly and offers no retreat.

lines.zh: 它把嘴张开又合上，像在掂量你。
lines.en: It opens and closes its mouth, weighing you up.

lines.zh: 它被撞得一偏，立刻掉头反冲。
lines.en: Knocked aside, it wheels and charges straight back.

lines.zh: 伤口的血让它更凶了。
lines.en: The blood from the wound only makes it fiercer.

lines.zh: 它退开半步，鱼群却围了上来。
lines.en: It backs off half a step, but the school closes in.

lines.zh: 它咬着疼处，尾巴还在打水。
lines.en: It flinches at the pain, tail still beating water.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，它反而盯得更紧。
lines.en: After the blow it only stares harder.

lines.zh: 它把受伤的一侧藏进鱼群里。
lines.en: It tucks its hurt side into the school.

lines.zh: 疼得它窜出礁缝，又冲回来。
lines.en: Pain shoots it out of the crevice and straight back in.

lines.zh: 它甩头，把水搅成一片白。
lines.en: It shakes its head, churning the water white.

lines.zh: 六点生命不算多，它却不肯退。
lines.en: Six points of life is not much, and still it will not retreat.

lines.zh: 受伤后它的攻击变得更直接。
lines.en: Wounded, its attacks grow blunter and more direct.

lines.zh: 你晃食物，它只是看着鱼群。
lines.en: You wave food; it only watches the school.

lines.zh: 它对掉进水里的饵毫无兴趣。
lines.en: It has no interest in bait dropped in the water.

lines.zh: 首领游向哪，它就跟向哪。
lines.en: Wherever the leader goes, it follows.

lines.zh: 你把鱼排递过去，它转身游开。
lines.en: You offer a fillet and it turns away.

lines.zh: 它只被同伴的身影吸引。
lines.en: Only the shapes of its schoolmates draw it.

lines.zh: 食物在水里打转，它连看都不看。
lines.en: Food spins in the water and it does not even look.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，是为了看清，不是为了吃。
lines.en: It comes close to look, not to feed.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不如首领一个摆尾。
lines.en: What you hold matters less than one flick of the leader's tail.

lines.zh: 它对诱饵没反应，对鱼群的动静很快。
lines.en: Bait does nothing; the school's motion does everything.

lines.zh: 它跟着同伴绕开你撒下的饵。
lines.en: It follows its schoolmates around the bait you scattered.

lines.zh: 它撞在你胸口，硬得让人一愣。
lines.en: It slams your chest, hard enough to startle.

lines.zh: 尾柄抽过来，水都被推开一条缝。
lines.en: Its tail stock lashes and the water parts in a seam.

lines.zh: 你挡在礁口，它直接顶了过来。
lines.en: You block the reef mouth and it rams straight through.

lines.zh: 它从你腰侧擦过，鳞片刮得生疼。
lines.en: It grazes your waist, scales scraping painfully.

lines.zh: 一群鱼撞上来，像一阵硬雨。
lines.en: The school hits you like a shower of hard rain.

lines.zh: 它不退，撞完还回头盯着你。
lines.en: It does not yield, and after the hit it stares back.

lines.zh: 你被顶得后退，脚在沙里打滑。
lines.en: The shove sends you back, feet sliding in the sand.

lines.zh: 它用吻部撞你的膝盖，一下比一下重。
lines.en: It butts your knee, each blow harder than the last.

lines.zh: 撞开你之后，它才慢慢游回队里。
lines.en: Only after shoving you aside does it rejoin the school.

lines.zh: 那一下不疼，可它明显是故意的。
lines.en: The blow barely hurts, but it was plainly deliberate.

lines.zh: 它没有伴侣，只跟着首领。
lines.en: It has no mate, only a leader to follow.

lines.zh: 同伴靠近，它用鳍碰了一下就走。
lines.en: A schoolmate nears; it brushes fins once and moves on.

lines.zh: 首领停住，它就守在旁边。
lines.en: The leader stops and it takes up guard beside it.

lines.zh: 两条鱼并肩游，却从不贴在一起。
lines.en: Two fish swim abreast yet never press together.

lines.zh: 它把位置让给首领，自己退后半步。
lines.en: It yields its place to the leader and drops back half a step.

lines.zh: 鱼群里没有配对，只有队形。
lines.en: The school has no pairs, only formation.

lines.zh: 它绕着同伴转一圈，又回到原位。
lines.en: It circles a schoolmate once and returns to its spot.

lines.zh: 谁离首领最近，谁就站得最直。
lines.en: Whoever stands nearest the leader stands straightest.

lines.zh: 它不会为谁留下，只会跟着队伍走。
lines.en: It stays for no one; it only follows the school.

lines.zh: 分开时它们没有告别，只是游开。
lines.en: When they part there is no goodbye, only distance.

lines.zh: 掉落的物品沉底，它绕着看了一眼。
lines.en: A dropped item sinks and it circles for a look.

lines.zh: 它捡起一小块贝壳，随即丢掉。
lines.en: It picks up a bit of shell and drops it.

lines.zh: 它对掉落物没有兴趣，只在意队形。
lines.en: It cares nothing for loot, only for formation.

lines.zh: 你丢出的东西它用吻顶了顶。
lines.en: It nudges what you threw with its snout.

lines.zh: 一块鱼肉落下，被别的鱼抢走了。
lines.en: A piece of fish falls and another fish steals it.

lines.zh: 它叼了一下，发现不能吃就松口。
lines.en: It mouths the thing, finds it inedible, and lets go.

lines.zh: 它把沉底的碎屑拨开，继续巡游。
lines.en: It brushes the sunken scraps aside and resumes patrol.

lines.zh: 物品卡在珊瑚缝里，它钻不进去。
lines.en: The item is wedged in coral and it cannot get in.

lines.zh: 它只对会动的东西张口。
lines.en: It opens its mouth only for things that move.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西，它从不带走。
lines.en: Whatever it picks up, it never carries off.

lines.zh: 它盯上了闯入礁区的一条鱼。
lines.en: It fixes on a fish that strayed into the reef.

lines.zh: 首领一转头，整群鱼都锁定了目标。
lines.en: The leader turns and the school locks on as one.

lines.zh: 它压低身体，眼睛盯住你的脚。
lines.en: It lowers its body, eyes pinned to your feet.

lines.zh: 有东西动了，它立刻选定了目标。
lines.en: Something moves and it picks its target at once.

lines.zh: 它不挑大的，只挑落单的。
lines.en: It picks no big prey, only the one alone.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游慢了半拍，被它记下。
lines.en: One fish lags half a beat and it takes note.

lines.zh: 它绕到目标侧面，找好角度。
lines.en: It swings to the target's flank and finds its angle.

lines.zh: 水草一抖，它就知道有东西躲着。
lines.en: The seagrass twitches and it knows something hides there.

lines.zh: 它锁定目标时，鱼群安静下来。
lines.en: When it locks on, the school falls silent.

lines.zh: 它要的不是食物，是驱赶。
lines.en: It is not after food; it wants you gone.

lines.zh: 你对它来说太大，可它还是选了。
lines.en: You are too big for it, and still it chooses you.

lines.zh: 它把身体对准你，尾鳍慢慢收紧。
lines.en: It squares up to you, tail fin tightening.

lines.zh: 目标一动，它的眼睛就跟着动。
lines.en: The target moves and its eye moves with it.

lines.zh: 它先选最靠边的那一个。
lines.en: It always picks the one nearest the edge.

lines.zh: 我闻到水里多了一点血味。
lines.en: A thread of blood reaches me in the water.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁后停了，我记住了。
lines.en: Something stopped behind the reef; I noted it.

lines.zh: 我绕到它的影子上方，算好了。
lines.en: I circle above its shadow and settle the angle.

lines.zh: 我盯住最慢的那条腿。
lines.en: I fix on the slowest of your legs.

lines.zh: 它贴着礁面加速，直冲目标。
lines.en: It hugs the reef face, accelerating straight at the target.

lines.zh: 鱼群从两侧包过来，路被堵死。
lines.en: The school closes from both sides; the way is shut.

lines.zh: 它一冲一停，逼得目标往角落退。
lines.en: It darts and halts, driving the target into a corner.

lines.zh: 距离一近，它的鳍全部张开。
lines.en: As the gap closes, all its fins flare open.

lines.zh: 目标想钻缝，它先一步堵住。
lines.en: The target tries a crevice and it blocks it first.

lines.zh: 它绕着珊瑚追，从不撞上枝杈。
lines.en: It chases around the coral without touching a branch.

lines.zh: 追到浅处，它也不肯放弃。
lines.en: Even in the shallows it refuses to break off.

lines.zh: 它逼你退到礁壁，退无可退。
lines.en: It backs you to the reef wall until there is nowhere left.

lines.zh: 它咬着不放，尾巴打得水响。
lines.en: It holds on, tail beating the water loud.

lines.zh: 队伍跟着它转，像一张收紧的网。
lines.en: The school turns with it, a net drawing tight.

lines.zh: 它一次次冲撞，试你的底线。
lines.en: It charges again and again, testing your limit.

lines.zh: 目标一转身，它已经等在那边。
lines.en: The target turns and it is already waiting there.

lines.zh: 它不叫，只用加速回答你的躲避。
lines.en: It makes no sound, answering your dodge with speed.

lines.zh: 它把目标赶出珊瑚，赶向空水。
lines.en: It drives the target off the coral into open water.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，把路让给后面的同伴。
lines.en: I tip sideways to let my school through.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，拖向礁石。
lines.en: I take its fin and drag it toward the reef.

lines.zh: 我贴着它转，逼它背对深水。
lines.en: I circle close until its back meets deep water.

lines.zh: 它往上浮，我先一步挡住水面。
lines.en: It rises; I block the surface first.

lines.zh: 我一次只进半格，逼它自己退。
lines.en: I close half a block at a time and let it retreat.

lines.zh: 我绕着它画圈，圈越来越小。
lines.en: I draw circles around it, each one smaller.

lines.zh: 它一头撞上来，力道比身形大得多。
lines.en: It rams you with force far beyond its size.

lines.zh: 一口咬在小腿上，牙齿细而利。
lines.en: A bite lands on your calf, teeth fine and sharp.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过水面，啪的一声。
lines.en: Its tail lashes the surface with a sharp crack.

lines.zh: 它咬住就甩头，想把你拽下水。
lines.en: It bites and shakes, trying to drag you under.

lines.zh: 一群鱼轮流冲撞，不给你喘息。
lines.en: The school charges in turns, giving you no breath.

lines.zh: 它撞你的手，把东西撞落水底。
lines.en: It strikes your hand and knocks the thing to the bottom.

lines.zh: 那一下咬得不深，可数量太多。
lines.en: The bites are shallow, but there are so many.

lines.zh: 它专挑关节和手指下口。
lines.en: It aims for joints and fingers.

lines.zh: 攻击之后它立刻退回队形里。
lines.en: After striking it withdraws straight into formation.

lines.zh: 它用吻部顶你的眼睛，逼你后退。
lines.en: It jabs at your eyes with its snout, forcing you back.

lines.zh: 咬完一口，水里的血丝散开。
lines.en: After the bite, threads of blood spread in the water.

lines.zh: 它撞得你手里的东西脱手。
lines.en: The impact knocks what you hold out of your grip.

lines.zh: 每次冲撞都算好了退路。
lines.en: Every charge is planned with its retreat in mind.

lines.zh: 它不缠斗，只反复地撞、咬、退。
lines.en: It never grapples, only strikes, bites, and withdraws.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁的缝隙里，它独自游了出来。
lines.en: From a gap in the coral reef it swims out alone.

lines.zh: 温水海洋的光里，多了一条小影子。
lines.en: A small shadow joins the light of the lukewarm ocean.

lines.zh: 海草床一抖，它从草叶间钻出。
lines.en: The seagrass shivers and it slips out between the blades.

lines.zh: 温暖浅海里，它先绕了一圈才停。
lines.en: In the warm shallows it circles once before settling.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋碎开，它出现时已经面朝你。
lines.en: The egg cracks and it appears already facing you.

lines.zh: 每次只来一条，可它从不显得孤单。
lines.en: Only one arrives each time, yet it never seems alone.

lines.zh: 它从礁影里升起，鱼群随后就到。
lines.en: It rises from the reef shadow, and the school follows.

lines.zh: 浅海的沙地上，它的影子先到。
lines.en: On the shallows' sand its shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 它出现的地方，别的小鱼都让开了。
lines.en: Where it appears, the smaller fish make way.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的白枝间，它慢慢转过身。
lines.en: Among white coral branches it turns slowly.

lines.zh: 它一出现就沿着礁脊巡逻。
lines.en: The moment it appears it begins patrolling the ridge.

lines.zh: 温水漫过礁石，它跟着水势上来。
lines.en: Warm water washes the rocks and it rises with the flow.

lines.zh: 它先看四周，再决定往哪游。
lines.en: It scans around before choosing a direction.

lines.zh: 一条鲹鱼，独自守在礁口。
lines.en: One trevally, alone on guard at the reef mouth.

lines.zh: 我从海草里钻出来，先看左边。
lines.en: I slip out of the seagrass and check left first.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的阴影动了一下，是我。
lines.en: The coral shadow moved; that was me.

lines.zh: 温暖浅海的沙上，我落下影子。
lines.en: My shadow lands on warm shallow sand.

lines.zh: 我出现时，水里的鱼先散了。
lines.en: When I arrive, the small fish scatter first.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖流上来，停在礁脊。
lines.en: I ride the warm current up and stop on the ridge.

lines.zh: 我先是水里的一个点，然后成了鱼。
lines.en: I am a dot in the water, then a fish.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，它被烤得贴着礁底。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and it presses flat to the reef.

lines.zh: 被甩上礁石，它拍着尾乱蹦。
lines.en: Flung onto the rocks, it flaps and thrashes.

lines.zh: 它张着嘴，鳃却没从水里得到什么。
lines.en: Its mouth works, but the gills get nothing from the water.

lines.zh: 爆风把它掀翻，鱼群一下子散尽。
lines.en: The blast flips it over and the school scatters completely.

lines.zh: 箭擦过背鳍，它转身去找射箭的人。
lines.en: An arrow grazes its dorsal fin and it turns to find the archer.

lines.zh: 白光裹住它，游动的方向乱了。
lines.en: White light wraps it and its heading falls apart.

lines.zh: 饿久了，它连珊瑚缝里的小蟹都翻。
lines.en: Long hungry, it digs even coral gaps for small crabs.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，水面亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and the surface glares white.

lines.zh: 没有水，它的鳍只能空摆。
lines.en: With no water, its fins can only beat empty space.
